title: Albumin–creatinine coupling adds little to cross-cycle handgrip prediction
abstract: A fixed serum albumin by log-creatinine interaction trained in4311 NHANES2011–2012 adults reduced weighted MSE by0.5574kg² (0.422%) in4858 adults from2013–2014 beyond flexible conventional measures. Target-only rescaled PSU bootstrap interval excluded zero, but source-target refit interval[−1.1637,+0.06885] included zero. Sex-specific laboratory effects shrank the gain to0.1037kg². This is small, baseline-sensitive exploratory temporal transport evidence, not a clinically useful biomarker. Prior cycle/outcome reuse precludes pristine confirmation.
